title: Your First Weekend at University of Notre Dame, Shared as Cards
description: An under-21-safe first-weekend route through documented campus landmarks, student spaces, recreation, and the arts.

cards.title: Begin with a campus orientation
cards.subtitle: Eck Visitors Center · Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Check the day’s general-tour times at Eck, then use the historical and social overview to get your bearings before exploring independently.
cards.short_summary: A guided opening that introduces the campus through its signature sites.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eck Visitors Center offers free public general tours, with registration in person beginning 30 minutes before the tour.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Tours | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: Tour dates and times vary; groups of 10 or more must arrange a private tour.

cards.title: Walk up to the Golden Dome
cards.subtitle: Main Building · First landmark loop
cards.notes: Pause outside the Main Building to identify the Golden Dome, then continue on foot toward the Basilica and the Grotto at an unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A landmark stop that anchors the first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame’s official tours identify the Main Building, known as the Golden Dome, as a regular campus-tour stop.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Tours | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: View from exterior paths; confirm building access locally if planning to enter.

cards.title: Take a self-guided Basilica visit
cards.subtitle: Basilica of the Sacred Heart · Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Enter respectfully for a self-guided look at the church or its museum, and defer to posted closures for liturgies, rehearsals, weddings, or funerals.
cards.short_summary: A quiet architectural and sacred-site visit with a public museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Basilica is open to the public year-round, welcomes self-guided visits, and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visits and Tours | Basilica of the Sacred Heart
cards.access_notes: Hours vary with the academic calendar; the Basilica and museum may close for services or events.

cards.entity_name: Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes
cards.title: Make time for the Grotto
cards.subtitle: Grotto · Reflective stop near the Basilica
cards.notes: Use this as a low-key pause: walk through quietly, sit for reflection if appropriate, and leave space for others who are praying.
cards.short_summary: A campus prayer and reflection site used throughout the day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame describes the Grotto as a sacred campus place where students, staff, alumni, and visitors come for quiet reflection and prayer.
cards.access_notes: Treat the site as an active prayer space; no purchase is required to visit.

cards.entity_name: Hesburgh Library and Word of Life mural
cards.title: Find the Word of Life mural
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Friday evening study reset
cards.notes: Approach the library façade for the mural, then head inside during open visitor hours to locate a study spot or browse the open stacks.
cards.short_summary: A landmark mural paired with the University’s flagship library.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame’s tour materials highlight the Word of Life mural, and Hesburgh Library provides study spaces and general research collections in open stacks.
cards.access_notes: Visitors are asked to leave at 8 p.m., when access becomes exclusive to current students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Regroup at LaFortune
cards.subtitle: LaFortune Student Center · Friday evening
cards.notes: Meet your group in the student center, check campus postings, and use the building as a practical reset point before choosing the next activity.
cards.short_summary: A central student-services building for gathering, eating, meetings, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame’s Student Activities Office manages LaFortune Student Center as one of its spaces to gather, eat, perform, meet, and study.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Office | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: Building access and individual food-service availability can change; check current notices on arrival.

cards.title: Schedule a recreational break
cards.subtitle: Rockne Memorial · Saturday daytime
cards.notes: Complete the required recreation waiver before arriving, then choose an available activity rather than assuming every amenity is open on a given day.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus recreation facility with courts, fitness equipment, and pools.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockne Memorial provides recreational facilities including cardio equipment, weight room, pools, racquetball and squash courts, and basketball courts.
cards.source_title: Rockne Memorial | RecSports | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: A RecSports waiver is required; the facility posts seasonal and modified hours, including closures.

cards.entity_name: Clarke Memorial Fountain and Fieldhouse Mall
cards.title: Walk through Fieldhouse Mall
cards.subtitle: Clarke Memorial Fountain and Fieldhouse Mall · Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Use the fountain as a map-checkpoint on a walking loop, then continue through the mall toward another listed campus destination without stepping into event setups.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor landmark on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame’s official campus map lists Clarke Memorial Fountain and Fieldhouse Mall as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access can be affected by weather, maintenance, or event operations.

cards.title: Check the arts calendar
cards.subtitle: DeBartolo Performing Arts Center · Saturday night
cards.notes: Choose an age-appropriate film, concert, theater, or dance event from the current calendar, and arrive early enough to clear ticketing and venue entry.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for recurring cinematic and performing-arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The DeBartolo Performing Arts Center presents cinematic and performing-arts programs and lists current upcoming events.
cards.source_title: Arts & Film at Notre Dame | DeBartolo Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Event availability, age guidance, and ticket requirements vary; lobby doors generally open at least one hour before events.

cards.title: Close with a campus event check
cards.subtitle: Duncan Student Center · Sunday planning stop
cards.notes: Stop in to review student-organization or campus-event information and make a simple plan for the week, keeping the first weekend’s momentum manageable.
cards.short_summary: A Student Activities-managed building designed for gathering, food, meetings, performance, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame’s Student Activities Office lists Duncan Student Center among the buildings it manages for gathering, eating, performing, meeting, and studying.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Office | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: Consult current building and event information on site; availability may vary by scheduled programming.
